_comment: THE image-architecture catalogue. Same doctrine as lib/transitions.json:
lib/styles.js (validation + the /api/styles route), the Settings UI and
scripts/image_gen.py (which builds the sd-cli argv) ALL read this one file,
so the dropdown and the renderer cannot disagree about what exists or about
which flag a text encoder is passed with.
Flag names were taken from stable-diffusion.cpp's own docs (docs/flux.md,
docs/flux2.md, docs/z_image.md, docs/qwen_image.md, docs/sd.md) and from
examples/cli/main.cpp, NOT from memory. Note that three of the five
architectures pass their text encoder with --llm, which is the same flag
worker.py already uses for the H3 text encoder.
sd.cpp is under active development and says so in its own README: if a flag
is renamed upstream, edit it HERE (one place) or override per style with

archs.label: FLUX.1 (dev / schnell)
archs.note: Distilled: cfg-scale 1.0 and no negative prompt. schnell needs about 4 steps, dev about 20.

archs.label: FLUX.2 klein 9B
archs.note: klein 9B is the distilled one: cfg 1.0, ~4 steps. The klein BASE 9B checkpoint wants cfg 4.0 and ~20 steps instead.

archs.label: FLUX 3 Image Klein (ComfyUI)
archs.note: 2.502.0: FLUX 3 Image Klein renders through ComfyUI only (0.41.0+; sd.cpp has no FLUX 3 yet). Distilled: cfg 1, 16 steps (4-16). Base: cfg 3.5, ~50 steps. Text and up to 10 reference pictures (<ref_image_0>...).

archs.label: Krea 2 (Turbo / Raw - ComfyUI)
archs.note: 2.516.0: Krea 2 (12B) renders through ComfyUI only (Krea 2 support: 0.26+). Turbo: 8 steps, cfg 1 (er_sde / simple). Raw: 52 steps, cfg 3.5 with a negative prompt. safetensors (models/diffusion_models) or GGUF (models/unet - ComfyUI-GGUF with Krea 2 support).

archs.label: Anima (anime - ComfyUI)
archs.note: 2.517.0: Anima (CircleStone Labs, 2B anime / illustration) renders through ComfyUI only. 30-50 steps, cfg 4-5 (er_sde), a negative prompt; start the prompt with 'masterpiece, best quality, score_7, safe, '. Aesthetic v1.1 or Base v1.0 (models/diffusion_models).

archs.label: MOSS-Image (SFT / Base - ComfyUI)
archs.note: 2.566.0: MOSS-Image (OpenMOSS, 5B, Apache-2.0) renders through ComfyUI only (16 Oct 2026 or later - the moss_image text encoder type). 25 steps, cfg 2.5, er_sde with skip layer guidance on layer 22 - ComfyUI's template (the official pipeline: 50 steps, cfg 3). SFT (instruction-tuned) or Base (for LoRAs); int8_convrot (5.4 GB) or bf16 in models/diffusion_models. Settings ▸ Add-ons ▸ MOSS-Image downloads them.

archs.label: Fibo 2.0 (Edit Turbo / Dev - ComfyUI)
archs.note: 2.582.0: Fibo 2.0 (Bria, 8B, CC BY-NC 4.0 - non-commercial) renders through ComfyUI only (21 Oct 2026 or later: CLIPLoader type fibo2 + TextEncodeFibo2). Edit Turbo: 4 steps, cfg 1 - edits a picture from an instruction (up to 4 pictures, <image_1>..<image_4>). Dev: 30 steps, cfg 5 - text to image and edits. Low VRAM: the w4a8 ConvRot file (6.6 GB) or GGUF Q4_0 (6.6 GB, ComfyUI-GGUF) + the int8 Qwen3-VL 4B. Settings ▸ Add-ons ▸ Fibo 2.0 downloads them.

archs.label: SDXL / SDXL-Turbo

vae.hint: sdxl_vae.safetensors (optional — most checkpoints bake one in)

archs.note: A full checkpoint, so it goes to -m and normally needs no separate VAE or text encoders. Turbo variants want cfg 1.0 and 1-4 steps.

archs.label: Z-Image (Turbo / Base)
archs.note: Turbo: cfg 1.0 and ~8 steps. Z-Image BASE wants cfg 5.0 instead. Runs in very little VRAM.

archs.label: Qwen-Image
archs.note: Very strong at rendering text inside the image. --flow-shift 3 is applied automatically unless your Extra args already set it.
